pins.d: moved to the 1:1 shoreline 2026-10-19 (was py 596: 592 m up, 6.7 km inland of the shore the open world's rule gives)

Moved 2026-10-23 with scale model 4.22 from 160,1007 (a water cell of the old 4.21 lake) to the north cliff over the great lake (1,638 m, ~1,340 m over the water at 298 m), where Dalab's road comes down; the arcology runs down the cliff to the shore (biomes/riftrim/PLAN.md section 12).

Beast Rider roost town on a red sandstone mesa (settlements/pinnacle-rock/PLAN.md). Moved 2026-10-18 from px 737,354 (approximate) to the knoll that clears the forest: 500-600 m over the jungle floor, the K'etsaal Baatar 11 km off. Moved 2026-11-10 (the owner: 'a spot not too far that's got a bit more forest') from 1027,681, which map 5.1 left in the NE rim's savanna, 41 km west to the savage hyperjungle's north-east edge: a knoll 110 m over its 14 km round (209 m prominence), -1,287 m, Aw, 1,490 mm, 77% of the ground within 9 km jungle; the Tsékooh Baatar 17 km off (openworld/PLAN-SITES.md, openworld/pinnacle).
restored 2026-10-18 at the seed14 position; the old Chichani capital on a lake of the Shim river (settlements/shim/PLAN.md)

The Talovolci's ceremonial settlement (the Cloud Giants). Moved 2026-10-23 from 608,798 (dry steppe in godstep valley, ~80 mm) into the cloud forest of the southern highlands: ~1.5 km, ~4,000 mm, Af, mean +18 C. LORE.md 6.21.

The Hill arcology (kits/ancients/targets/hill), on the east flank of the springs' hollow through the Catch's interior hills, at the biggest of its five oases. A glorified campground of a couple of hundred people (merchants, caravans, arcology divers); the Ancients' tunnel from here is sealed halfway (biomes/catch/PLAN.md). Moved 2026-10-23 from 827,1113.

Arcoindian II (kits/ancients/targets/arcoindian2), ruined, built into the west wall of the N Outlands' main basin over the 2,132 m lake. The Coyote Men shun it as cursed: they say the trickster lives there, and the god's road ends here. biomes/outlands/PLAN.md, SURVEY.md; the owner, 2026-10-26.
Gateway to the Throne, a layered city (Zeijani, Western Islander, Izani, Hykkousoi, Voth since ~30 years ago): settlements/zeydanin/PLAN.md. Typed city 2026-10-18 (was village).

The greatest haven and fortress of the Free Giants (the Vrivolci, LORE.md 6.17, 6.21) and a sanctuary for escaped slaves of every people fleeing the Vothic Kingdom and the Realm of Dalab. Built of cyclopean columnar basalt and tier-cedar murus gallicus on the middle flood-basalt lava terrace of Greenstep (+1,980 m, Cfa/Cfb) above the confluence of the Clodosriba lava-tube rilles. Called Talodunon in their borrowed Talovolci Gaulish and Da-Talwal in Vrivolci creole. biomes/greenstep/PLAN.md.
Central intra-crater shield volcano (+10.9 km) rising above the Ring Sea into the hypobaric rim.
25.0 km stagnant-lid super-shield on the southern Crater rim, piercing high into the airless O exosphere.
Broad +6.3 km basaltic shield volcano in the NE highlands with a snow-rimmed summit caldera.

Submerged-terrace megalithic citadel on Lake Capsica (+2.08 km), built by a distinct Ancient culture that naturalized Earthly green flora here; their descendants may be the ancestors of the cross-sea merchants who arrive at Farport.
Ancient lake-outlet locks and terraced green orchards at the western outlet of Lake Capsica, facing downriver toward the Great NW Ocean sea-lanes to Farport.
Overgrown stepped botanical terraces of naturalized Earthly green groves on Lake Capsica's eastern shore, fading outward into native iridescent blue-green cloud forest.
Vast ~24M km² stagnant-lid marine sag basin (~1.9× the 5.1 map) extending NW from Farport and Ria Delta across the equator, traversed by the mysterious cross-sea merchants who sail into Farport.

Segmented mid-ocean ridge & en-echelon serpentinite horst archipelago extending SW from 5.1's Arch & Steaming Seamounts across the Great NW Ocean; Earthly coastal flora dispersing from Ria Delta and The Crook fades gradually into native iridescent blue-green & retinol-purple canopies.

Continuous NE major-axis extension of 5.1's Arch hugging offshore of the Ria Barrier sea-cliffs and shoaling into the warm Capsican Equatorial Monsoon Gulf — a natural stepping-stone route between Lake Capsica's western rivers and Farport.
Steep +10–11 km heat-pipe basalt shields rising from −4.1 km abyssal plain; catastrophic submarine flank slumps here generate the mega-tsunamis striking 5.1's Tsunami Coast.

Continuous +7.5–10.8 km (<0.64 atm HT/HF/O) folded hyperalpine cordillera sealing off North Ria from the Great NW Ocean sea-cliffs eastward into the Korona–Tharn Uplands and blocking northward Earth-flora migration except via Carnelian Pass.

The sole narrow (~35–50 km floor, +2.01 km sill at Carnelian Pass 15.76°S, 44.14°W) trans-barrier gorge threading northward out of Ria Valley through the Ria Barrier Cordillera, funneling a fading tongue of Earthly green flora toward West Capsica.
Lush Af/Am/Aw equatorial rainforest north of the Ria Barrier where pioneer Earthly green flora from Carnelian Pass yields smoothly to native Kratorian retinol-purple & iridescent blue-green jungles.

Deep Tharnian Otz-style −1.7 to −2.8 km (1.98–2.27 atm) lithospheric flexural foredeep along the southern foot of the Capsican Cordillera; steaming pockets exceed Twb ≥ 35°C (XD deadly wet-bulb hothouse) amid native retinol-purple XA/XV jungles.
Western cratonic wing (+2.1–3.6 km, Cwb/Cfb) of the continuous Capsican Continental Highland, draped in native iridescent blue-green cloud forests and drained westward toward the Great NW Ocean.

Heart of the 11,000 km Capsican Continental Highland (+2.4–4.1 km, Cwb/BSk): native phycobilin blue-green & violet canopies give way around Lake Capsica to a striking ring of naturalized Earthly green flora left by a vanished Ancient culture.

Titicaca-class +2.05 km (1.24 atm, WH) highland sea ringed by naturalized Earthly green flora that fades outward into native blue-green canopies. Canonical center of Ancient settlement by a distinct, non-Crater culture; their fate is unknown to Krator's inhabitants, though their descendants may be the ancestors of the cross-sea merchants who arrive at Farport.
Eastern wing (+2.2–3.7 km, Cwb/Cwa) of the Capsican Highland enclosing an interior rain-shadowed BSk/BWk steppe depression analogous to Capsica's interior tables.

Continuous ENE mantle-plume uplift extending out of 5.1's Korona & Tharn Uplands toward (0°, 0°), featuring breached elliptical volcano-tectonic coronae, deep hyperbaric moat troughs, quartzite tepuis, and HG fumarolic cryo-oases.

Breached volcano-tectonic corona and −1.5 to −2.7 km (1.93–2.24 atm) hyperbaric rift basin at (0°, 0°); hosts XE sub-giant eclipse-chill monsoon benches and XD deadly wet-bulb shores under daily Giant eclipses.
Towering +17.2 km Olympus-class stagnant-lid mega-shield with summit caldera and basal fault scarp, piercing into the airless O zone (>9 km) beside the Sub-Giant Point.
Deep sunken equatorial rift sea (−1.75 km surface) on the eastern Capsican Equator, ringed by steaming XD deadly wet-bulb hothouses and native retinol-purple XA/XV jungles.
Io-style flat-floored XL patera lava-lake heat islands floored by active flood basalts that elevate local air temperatures by +6–9°C.

Broad East-Abyss & Afar-class lobate pull-apart depressions (−1.6 to −3.9 km, 1.95–2.60 atm) beyond the eastern flank of the broad East Tharn Highlands: two-step fault benches and cloud-crowned en-echelon horst mesas divide wide XV/XS abyssal savannahs, rose-potash & halite pans, maar-lake archipelagos, and island-studded WX soda seas.

Broad +4.5–9.8 km (ET/EF/HT/HF/O) dissected continental highland & glaciated plateau massif backing the entire eastern side of the 5.1 Crater and Rift complex before stepping down eastward into the East Abyssal pull-apart basins.

Grand pinch-and-swell segmented rift province (260–480 km wide) wrapping south of the East Tharn Highlands from 5.1's Rift & High Rift: canyon-incised two-step fault benches and en-echelon cloud-forest horst blocks enclose scalloped cobalt, celadon-algal, rose-potash, and turquoise sub-basin lakes.

Stepped WNW volcanic rift propagating out of 5.1's Firebliss Range across the Western Crater Ejecta Rampart: descends from high geothermal sinter-lake basins through Ignis Patera into the drowned marine Ignis Firth.
Thick EF/HF maritime polar ice sheet (+4.6–7.0 km) nourished by moisture-bearing westerlies sweeping poleward off the Great NW Ocean.

Ancient +5.0–9.6 km (<0.74 atm ET/HT/HF/O) megabreccia continent near the leading orbital apex, bounded along the Great NW Ocean by an articulated coastal cordillera that walls off deep −2.5 to −3.6 km interior hyperbaric XA/XV/XS foredeep troughs.
Scalloped, slump-terraced Heloon-style multi-ring impact basins (−2.0 to −2.8 km, 2.05–2.27 atm) inside Leading Terrae, trapping warm endorheic lakes and lush hyperbaric XA/XV refugia.

Scale-Model-5.1-style 3-zone Noctis Labyrinthus & Martian Chaos complex carved into a +5–6.8 km glaciated dome antipodal to the Throne impact: progresses from W/SW beaded pit-crater catenae through a central 3-trend diamond-bastion fault-graben maze into a sunken E/NE hyperbaric Chaos Amphitheatre (−1.4 to −2.8 km) of tilted polyhedral horst mesas, knobby pyramids, and chaos-moat lakes breaching into the Boreal Farside Sea.
